system.description:
Once per encounter, as part of the action you use to attack, your first attack that turn has Advantage and deals maximum damage if it hits, with no rolling.

    • 15th level: every attack that turn has Advantage and deals maximum damage if it hits.

rules.value: Legend of Battle: {1:your first attack this turn deals maximum damage if it hits, 15:every attack this turn deals maximum damage if it hits}.
